results.description:
Pokopia is huge. Tangrome helps you make sense of it.

Tangrome is an ad-free Pokopia companion built for fast lookup, smarter planning, and progress tracking. The full encyclopedia is free, works offline, and helps in every step of your journey.

Build your daily routine
- Dailies is a free checklist for the things you do each day in Pokopia. It's not just a plain to-do list.
- Check off single actions or repeat goals.
- Pin a focus item so you remember exactly what you are after.
- Build a streak for back-to-back days.
- Link a daily to a Build Plan.
- Start from premade actions or create your own from scratch.

Create Complex Build Plans
- Build Plans turns recipes, habitats, and items into organized projects.
- Add several entries in one go.
- Your build plans and gives you a clear material summary so you don't have to hunt around.
- Choose how what you want to build, arrange your work, and keep finished projects as a reference in your archive.

Track all of your progress
- Tangrome allows you to track everything in the game: Pokemon, Habitats, Items, Recipes, Highlights, Human Records... you name it, you can track it!
- Tracking goes beyond the normal checklist; keep records of what's stored where and in what box and plan out Pokemon homes and habitats so you can see everything at one glance.
- Have multiple games and can't remember what you've done on each? Tangrome lets you save up to 4 different tracking records through separate save slots on the same account.

Rich encyclopedia with easy references
- Tangrome lists everything beautifully and makes it easy to find what you need.
- Entries link to related entries; see details about materials, where a Pokemon can be found, the recipe for an item all without searching through tons of lists.
- Fast, easy, and comprehensive search

Offline by default
Encyclopedia works fully offline. No waiting on pages to load. No dependence on a live connection. No data collected.

Single purchase to unlock everything
The encyclopedia and dailies checklist are free to use, forever! If you need more, like tracking, build plans, or storage keeping, pay once and it's yours. No scammy subscriptions. No ads. Just a good app. Pay when you find the need for upgrades.

Made for every Apple screen
Use Tangrome for quick lookups on iPhone, switch to your iPad to have a dedicated information screen, or move to your Mac to really plan out your next build in detail. And any upgrades you purchase are unlocked on EVERY device.

Privacy by default
No ads. No third-party analytics. No third-party trackers. No runtime content fetching. Your data stays on your device. Keep it, I don't want it.

Tangrome is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Nintendo, The Pokemon Company, GAME FREAK, or any of their affiliates.
All game-related names, trademarks, and other intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

results.description:
Enter a quiet, modern game room built around one focused challenge: place five stones in a row before your opponent does. Play the strong on-device opponent anywhere, face a DeepSeek-powered cloud player when connected, or share one device for a two-player match.

Open the app for a quick round on a commute, practise a difficult position offline, or return to a saved match to study where the game changed.

Features:
• 15×15 freestyle Gomoku with black moving first
• One strong, varied offline opponent powered by local-v6
• Optional DeepSeek cloud matches with engine-guided move selection
• Pass-and-play for two people on one device
• Saved match records with step-by-step replay
• Undo up to 3 times per AI game; each undo rewinds your and the AI’s latest round. Without an active AI Pass, one rewarded ad unlocks all 3 undos; an active pass grants them directly. After an undo, eligible ranked games use the final valid game record; finished games cannot be undone.
• Local records and opt-in seasonal leaderboards for challenge score, wins, win rate, fastest wins, and streaks; choose a season and view past history
• Move preview, haptics, sound, reduced motion, and 12 interface languages

No social account is required. Match records remain on your device by default. Cloud play sends the board state and the anonymous session data needed to run the match. Joining public seasonal rankings is optional and is explained before any nickname or verified result is uploaded.

DeepSeek is used as a third-party AI service and is not affiliated with this app.

Was im Büro eingetragen wird, ist sofort auf dem Handy. Was draußen erledigt wird, sieht das Büro sofort.

Server in Deutschland.

Odbory TOSHULIN jsou uzavřená členská aplikace pro ověřené členy ZO OS KOVO TOS Hulín.

  Aplikace nabízí na jednom místě:

  • novinky a důležitá oznámení
  • přehled připravovaných akcí
  • členské dokumenty ke stažení
  • kontakty a informace o členech výboru
  • hlavní skupinový chat
  • samostatný chat pro oprávněné členy výboru
  • nastavitelná push upozornění

  Uživatelé mohou v chatu sdílet zprávy a podporované přílohy, skrýt jiného uživatele a nahlásit nevhodný obsah. Součástí aplikace jsou také
  odkazy na podporu, pravidla chatu, podmínky používání, ochranu osobních údajů a podání žádosti o zrušení účtu.

  Aplikace není určena k veřejné registraci. Členské účty vytváří a spravuje oprávněný zástupce odborové organizace.
